Definition: of Chaldee origin (H1247 and H3091); son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite:--Barjesus.
BiblicalUsage: Bar-jesus, also called Elymas the sorcerer, is the false prophet Paul and Barnabas meet on Cyprus. He tries to turn the deputy Sergius Paulus away from the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bar-jesus shows how a holy name can be worn by an unholy man, because son of Jesus he is called, yet he stands against the gospel, and Paul's blindness upon him is God's answer to a sorcerer who would blind others.
